java_locations.role: Defines the complete inline and multiline named-note command forms. The inline form uses `%g` for both delimiters and excludes every `%g` character from DISPLAY; malformed codes or decoration order do not produce a note command result.

Expands `%g` to the four-character double-quote alphabet: ASCII quote, Unicode left double quote, Unicode right double quote, and Jaws.BLOCK_E1_INVISIBLE_QUOTE. The grammar does not require the two delimiters to be the same member.
Defines the fourth `%g` delimiter as private-use code point U+E121, used by Jaws preprocessing for invisible quotes.

Defines each tag body as characters excluding whitespace, braces, angle brackets, dollar signs, and every `%g` member. Pattern2 performs the same four-character quote substitution inside this suffix grammar as it does around DISPLAY.
Keeps a recognized multiline named-note opener in OK_PARTIAL state until the registered endnote/end note regex matches the final line.

Requires every source line to be consumed by a registered command. A partial multiline candidate that reaches EOF without becoming OK returns null, so the diagram factory is rejected rather than accepting or discarding the accumulated body.
Returns syntax-error output when no diagram factory can consume the complete source.

rust_locations.role: The ownership predicates now retain the uniquely owned opener, but named_note_decorations excludes only ASCII double quote from tag bodies. A left quote, right quote, or U+E121 therefore succeeds before terminal ownership rejection can run.

Uses a shared in_note body state for multiline commands. It consumes every later line until a terminator but has no EOF validation, so an unfinished named note silently discards its body and any swallowed declarations or relations.
Its note_accum state likewise consumes every later line and is not checked at EOF, returning an accepted diagram after silently dropping the unfinished note and swallowed syntax.

claimed_invariant: In Java's DESCRIPTION command inventory, `note` followed by whitespace and any Pattern2 `%g` delimiter uniquely enters CommandFactoryNote's inline command domain; no attached-note, note-on-link or other registered factory shares that opener. A fully valid command requires a non-empty DISPLAY containing no `%g`, then any `%g` closing delimiter, `as`, CODE and ordered decorations. Every Stereotag body also excludes the complete `%g` alphabet. The multiline `note as CODE` form remains an owned partial command until endnote/end note closes it; EOF while partial rejects the diagram. Once either unique opener is present, failure anywhere in that command state rejects the candidate. Component and Deployment do not reinterpret the line, accept malformed decorations, or silently discard an unfinished body and later swallowed syntax.
causal_divergence: Rust originally collapsed command non-match and validation failure into None. The ownership corrections now claim the full inline opener, but successful suffix parsing still implements Stereotag with an ASCII-only quote exclusion. U+201C, U+201D, and U+E121 inside a tag therefore produce a successful NamedNoteCommand even though Pattern2 substitutes `%g` into Java's tag grammar and rejects them. Independently, Component's in_note and Deployment's note_accum represent a recognized multiline command but have no rejecting transition at EOF. Both consume later declarations and relations as body, then return Ok while discarding the unfinished accumulator. The shared causal defect is incomplete preservation of Java's owned command state through suffix validation and stream termination.
planned_model_change: Make named_note_decorations exclude the same four-member `%g` alphabet from every tag body that parse_named_note_inline uses for DISPLAY boundaries. Preserve the family parsers' multiline command ownership through EOF: record the opener source line for every multiline note state, clear it only on a valid terminator, and return ParseError if input ends while the state remains active. This follows CommandMultilines2/PSystemCommandFactory rather than trying to recover swallowed declarations after the fact. Add Component and Deployment regressions for all three previously omitted tag quote characters and for unterminated bodies followed by declaration/relation-shaped lines. Attached and note-on-link multiline states share Java's terminator requirement and may use the same EOF transition; their grammar and AST ownership otherwise remain outside this mechanism.
perturbation_axes: ASCII versus curly versus mixed versus Jaws `%g` delimiters
invalid code versus tag/stereotype/color order versus unresolved color
invalid command before versus after ordinary declarations
later relation to the would-be code versus no later relation
valid attached-note controls and non-owned note-on-link prefixes
tag bodies containing ASCII, left, right, and U+E121 `%g` members under independently varied outer delimiters
terminated versus unterminated multiline commands followed by declaration- and relation-shaped body lines
acceptance: The preserved invalid punctuation, reordered-decoration, single-character-color and composite-color sources return parser errors before later endpoint creation.
No invalid source creates a note, component, interface, deployment node, relation or UID event.
Valid inline and multiline named notes in both families still parse with their complete decorations.
Attached notes remain unaffected, while note-on-link lines remain outside this factory's ownership predicate.
Tag bodies containing any Pattern2 `%g` member reject before a note or later endpoint can be created.
Component and Deployment reject EOF with an active multiline note state and do not silently drop swallowed declarations or relations.
An independent checker attacks command prefix boundaries, family, nesting, error cause and later-line mutation.
forbidden_approaches: deleting synthetic entities after parsing later relations
special-casing reviewed invalid strings or fixture codes
silently dropping only the invalid decoration while creating the note
treating every line beginning with `note` as CommandFactoryNote-owned
declared_residue: Deployment's missing valid note-on-link behavior belongs to CommandFactoryNoteOnLink and requires a separate causal account, implementation and checker record.
Plain floating `note : ...` is not valid Java Description-diagram syntax and is not an acceptance control for this mechanism.
Other malformed note factories outside the two named-note prefixes require their own command-ownership analysis.
Top-level multi-factory subtype selection remains a separate consumability mechanism.
Java error SVG artwork and diagnostic wording remain separate from parser acceptance and AST non-mutation.
